title: Daily Standup Meeting
scenario: Three developers give their daily status update. Listen to the whole standup, then answer the questions.
scenarioPersian: سه برنامه‌نویس گزارش روزانه می‌دهند. کل جلسه را گوش بده و بعد به سوال‌ها جواب بده.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.english: Morning everyone, quick round — yesterday, today, blockers. Dana, go ahead.
lines.persian: صبح بخیر، یک دور سریع — دیروز، امروز، موانع. دانا شروع کن.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.english: Yesterday I finished the search endpoint and merged it. Today I'm starting on pagination. No blockers.
lines.persian: دیروز endpoint جستجو را تمام و merge کردم. امروز صفحه‌بندی را شروع می‌کنم. مانعی ندارم.

lines.speaker: Omid
lines.english: I was debugging the flaky login test most of yesterday. It turned out to be a timing issue with the mock server. Fix is up for review. Today I'll pick up the password reset ticket, but I'm blocked on the email service credentials.
lines.persian: دیروز بیشتر وقتم صرف دیباگ تست ناپایدار لاگین شد. مشکل از تایمینگ سرور mock بود. اصلاحیه در حال بازبینی است. امروز تیکت بازنشانی رمز را برمی‌دارم اما منتظر اطلاعات سرویس ایمیل هستم.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.english: I'll chase the credentials right after this — should be with you before lunch.
lines.persian: بلافاصله بعد از جلسه پیگیری می‌کنم — قبل از ناهار به دستت می‌رسد.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.english: Quick one from me: the staging deploy failed last night because of a missing environment variable. I've fixed the config and redeployed — everything is green now. Today I'm on code review and the performance dashboard.
lines.persian: من کوتاه می‌گویم: دیپلوی staging دیشب به خاطر یک متغیر محیطی جاافتاده شکست خورد. تنظیمات را درست و دوباره دیپلوی کردم — الان همه چیز سبز است. امروز روی بازبینی کد و داشبورد کارایی کار می‌کنم.

lines.speaker: Lead
lines.english: Great. Reminder: feature freeze is Thursday, so anything for the release needs to be in review by Wednesday afternoon.
lines.persian: عالی. یادآوری: فریز قابلیت‌ها پنجشنبه است، پس هر چیزی برای ریلیز باید تا بعدازظهر چهارشنبه در بازبینی باشد.

learningObjectives: Understand workplace status updates and blockers

exercises.audioText: Yesterday I finished the search endpoint and merged it. Today I'm starting on pagination. No blockers.

exercises.audioText: I was debugging the flaky login test most of yesterday. It turned out to be a timing issue with the mock server.
exercises.prompt: What caused the flaky login test?
options: A timing issue with the mock server
exercises.explanation: 'It turned out to be a timing issue with the mock server.'

exercises.audioText: Today I'll pick up the password reset ticket, but I'm blocked on the email service credentials.
exercises.explanation: 'I'm blocked on the email service credentials.'

exercises.prompt: What is the current state of staging?
options: Rolled back to last week's version
exercises.explanation: 'I've fixed the config and redeployed — everything is green now.'

exercises.audioText: Feature freeze is Thursday, so anything for the release needs to be in review by Wednesday afternoon.
exercises.prompt: What is the deadline for code to be in review?
exercises.explanation: Freeze Thursday → review by Wednesday afternoon.
